actions.description: See today's menu once it is published
Create, edit and publish today's menu, in any status
Close ordering for today, for good
The caller's own order for today
Place, change or cancel the caller's own order while ordering is open

groups.name: Lunch Office Managers
groups.description: People who run the daily lunch order

roles.name: Staff
roles.description: Sees today's published menu and places, changes or cancels their own order until ordering closes. Never sees anyone else's order and cannot edit the menu or close ordering.

roles.name: Office Manager
roles.description: Builds, publishes and edits today's menu, closes ordering and sees everyone's orders. Cannot order lunch with this role.
